title: 2024 AMC 12A Problem 10
statement: Let \(\alpha\) be the radian measure of the smallest angle in a \(3\text{-}4\text{-}5\) right triangle. Let \(\beta\) be the radian measure of the smallest angle in a \(7\text{-}24\text{-}25\) right triangle. In terms of \(\alpha,\) what is \(\beta?\)

solutions.text: The smallest angle of the \(3\text{-}4\text{-}5\) triangle has \(\tan\alpha=\tfrac34.\) Then \[ \begin{aligned} &\tan2\alpha=\frac{2\cdot\frac34}{1-\frac{9}{16}} \\ &=\frac{\frac{3}{2}}{\frac{7}{16}}=\frac{24}{7}. \end{aligned} \] The smallest angle of the \(7\text{-}24\text{-}25\) triangle has \(\tan\beta=\tfrac{7}{24}=\cot2\alpha\) \(=\tan\!\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}-2\alpha\right).\) Hence \(\beta=\tfrac{\pi}{2}-2\alpha.\) Thus, the correct answer is C.
